content: Multi-tenant RBAC mistakes: trusting a tenant/workspace ID from client request instead of verified token claims allows cross-tenant data access with a single modified request; roles not explicitly scoped to a tenant/workspace become dangerously global (an 'Admin' role without tenant context = global privilege); authorization must be enforced server-side as source of truth, checked at every level of a resource hierarchy (org->workspace->skill), and tested with explicit cross-tenant-access-must-fail tests.
